title: Phase 1: schema migration 026_catalog_market_matches.sql + pendingMigrations entry
description: Add helios/src/server/db/migrations/026_catalog_market_matches.sql creating fuzzy_skus and catalog_market_matches per the data-model section of docs/helios/catalog-market-data/EPIC_PLAN.md. Forward-only, additive, both tables empty at the start. Add entries to helios/src/server/db/pendingMigrations.ts so an unmigrated prod env surfaces the apply-this-migration banner instead of crashing at first read. Includes the partial unique index on (catalog_group_id, fuzzy_sku_id) where superseded_by_id is null and the brand/source/(brand, category, size) indexes called out in the plan. No server code references the new tables yet; this leaf only lays the schema.

title: Phase 2: deterministic confidence scorer shared/marketMatch/confidence.ts + property tests
description: Implement the scorer documented in EPIC_PLAN.md as a pure function at helios/src/shared/marketMatch/confidence.ts: scoreCatalogFuzzy(catalogProfile, fuzzyProfile, knownVerdict?) -> number in [0,1]. Per-field factor functions (brand_factor, category_factor, subcat_factor, size_factor, pack_factor, strain_factor) extracted as named helpers so they're individually unit-testable. Brand alias seed data ported out of BRAND_MANUFACTURER_ALIASES in helios/src/worker/pricing/litAlertsMarket.ts into a small brand_aliases reference table (and a tiny seed loader so v1 doesn't yet require an admin UI). Tests: snapshot of the formula against fixture catalog/fuzzy pairs, property test for per-field monotonicity (improving one factor cannot reduce overall score), exhaustive verdict post-filter coverage (no_match -> 0, exact -> clamp >= 0.99, brand_family -> clamp into [0.5, 0.85]).

title: Phase 3: backfill worker — parse existing litalerts_competitor_observations into fuzzy_skus
description: New worker job configWorkersFuzzySkuBackfillJob (or one-off script under helios/scripts/) that scans litalerts_competitor_observations and emits one fuzzy_skus row per observation using parser_id='litalerts.partner.v1', parser_version='1.0.0' (placeholder pending epic E). raw_input_jsonb is the observation row verbatim; parsed_jsonb is the result of running the existing inline LitAlerts parsing logic (size/strain/pack extraction lifted from litAlertsMarket.ts). Re-run-safe: the (source_kind, source_listing_id, parser_id, parser_version, raw_input_hash) uniqueness handles duplicates. Outputs a count summary (parsed / skipped / failed / unique brands seen) and writes failures to a separate fuzzy_sku_backfill_failures audit table for operator review.

title: Phase 4: reviewer UI page + REST surface (Catalog → Market Data)
description: Add server routes GET /catalog/market-matches (page shell + initial payload), GET /api/catalog/market-matches?group=:id, GET /api/catalog/market-matches/candidates?group=:id&limit=:n, POST /api/catalog/market-matches in helios/src/server/routes/. Add corresponding SPA page under the Catalog area following the UX rules in helios/AGENTS.md: primary triage table above the fold, methodology / hidden-by-no_match / cross-brand chrome collapsed in <details>. Keyboard shortcuts e/b/n/s for exact/brand_family/no_match/skip. POST creates a new catalog_market_matches row and supersedes any prior live row for the (group, fuzzy_sku) pair. Uses the Phase-2 scorer for candidate ranking. Tests: per-route integration tests (insert verdict, supersedes prior, blacklist excludes from candidates) and a Playwright smoke test of the keyboard workflow.

title: Phase 5a: pricing cutover read-also + /diagnostics/pricing-match-diff dashboard
description: Modify helios/src/worker/pricing/litAlertsMarket.ts so buildPricingMarketContext() ALSO loads the persisted catalog_market_matches verdicts for the in-scope catalog groups, in parallel with the existing inline fuzzy match. Pricing still uses the inline path; the persisted path's output is captured into a pricing_match_diff (or piggy-backed on existing pricing audit table) row recording {catalog_group_id, inline_matched_listing_ids[], persisted_matched_listing_ids[], inline_only[], persisted_only[]}. Add a /diagnostics/pricing-match-diff page (server-rendered, top-of-page = bucket counts and worst-disagreement table; full per-group diffs collapsed under <details>) so operators can see whether the persisted path is ready to take over. No behavior change to pricing decisions. Tests: contrived fixture where the verdicts disagree, asserting diff capture + dashboard rendering.

title: Phase 5b: pricing read-only behind USE_PERSISTED_MARKET_MATCHES per-tenant flag
description: Add a per-tenant boolean USE_PERSISTED_MARKET_MATCHES (default off) to the existing tenant feature-flag surface. When the flag is on for a tenant, buildPricingMarketContext() uses ONLY the persisted catalog_market_matches verdicts for that tenant's catalog groups; the inline fuzzy match is skipped for those groups. When the flag is off, behavior is identical to Phase 5a (inline drives decisions, persisted feeds the diff dashboard). Tests: with-flag and without-flag goldens against the same fixture; explicit assertion that the inline code path is not entered when the flag is on.

title: Phase 5c: flip USE_PERSISTED_MARKET_MATCHES default on, leave override
description: After Phase 5b has been stable in prod for at least a week with at least one tenant flipped on and zero unexplained pricing diffs, flip the default of USE_PERSISTED_MARKET_MATCHES from off to on. Keep the per-tenant override so an operator can roll back individually if a regression appears. No code shape change; literally one default-value flip plus a paragraph in the runbook.

title: Phase 5d: delete legacy inline fuzzy-match code from litAlertsMarket.ts
description: After Phase 5c has been stable in prod for at least a week with zero rollbacks, delete brandMatchCache, GENERIC_SEARCH_WORDS, BRAND_MANUFACTURER_ALIASES (moved to the brand_aliases reference table in Phase 2), ProductComparableProfile, PRICING_SEARCH_ADAPTATION_* and the LLM-assisted search-adaptation flow from helios/src/worker/pricing/litAlertsMarket.ts. Remove the USE_PERSISTED_MARKET_MATCHES flag and its default-off code path. Update litAlertsMarket.test.ts to drop the inline-match assertions. Keep the partnerClient + retailer fan-out (Phase 1 of the market-data-sweep epic still needs those for raw observation refresh).

title: Phase 6: background re-rank cron + auto-promote ≥0.99 system-inferred 'exact'
description: New worker job configWorkersCatalogMarketMatchRescoreJob running every 6h. For every (catalog_group_id, fuzzy_sku_id) pair currently un-verdicted: recompute the scorer (against latest catalog and fuzzy-sku state) and, if score >= 0.99 AND no live no_match exists for the pair AND brand_factor == 1.0 (no alias hop), insert a catalog_market_matches row with verdict='exact', verdict_set_by_user_id='system', verdict_set_via='system_inferred', confidence_at_verdict=score. Pageable summary on the /diagnostics/pricing-match-diff page (or its own page) showing today's auto-promotions for spot-audit. Tests: cron triggers exactly the eligible pairs; a pair with a live no_match is never auto-promoted; the auto-promotion is itself superseded if a human later flips it to brand_family or no_match.

title: Phase 7: RUNBOOK.md + operator docs
description: Write docs/helios/catalog-market-data/RUNBOOK.md covering: how to apply migration 026 and verify (pendingMigrations probe), how to read catalog_market_matches in production via psql, how to flip USE_PERSISTED_MARKET_MATCHES per tenant, how to interpret the /diagnostics/pricing-match-diff dashboard, what to do when a tenant reports a pricing regression after Phase 5c flip (per-tenant rollback procedure), how the catalog-group reconcile job has to remap catalog_market_matches.catalog_group_id (per Open Question 4 in EPIC_PLAN.md). Add a top-of-file note to docs/helios/catalog-market-data/README.md pointing at the runbook.
